To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ACI is a transparent infrastructure to enable Internet-based collaboration between engineers during design of complex systems.

(a) ACI provides a flexible and transparent environment for collaborative engineering, (b) ACI is based on open standards, (c) ACI provides secure data transfer, (d) ACI is independent of network technology, (e) ACI provides plug-and-play functionality, (f) ACI provides tool integration and data exchange with XML.
ACI is a middleware infrastructure for distributed, secure, and transparent collaboration in EDA.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: - The development of advanced collaborative engineering infrastructure (ACI); - The development of an XML-based tool integration platform; - The development of a secure, peer-topeer, and XML-based data transfer mechanism; - The development and evaluation of a collaborative engineering platform for electronic design automation; - The development, implementation, and evaluation of collaborative engineering tools; - The establishment of a collaborative research network in Europe.
the development of a pan-European collaborative engineering environment for EDA.
the development of an open and secure infrastructure for collaborative engineering.

ACI provides a secure and reliable infrastructure for collaborative research and engineering in EDA.

the presented infrastructure is able to support the collaborative engineering of complex electronic systems in an efficient, secure, and flexible manner.

ACI provides the infrastructure to enable collaborative engineering for complex electronic systems.

we have developed a new approach to collaborative engineering, which is not only based on a secure, transparent, and scalable infrastructure but also provides an open interface to XML-based tool integration and a flexible data transfer.

a collaborative infrastructure for EDA can be established by a careful combination of existing technologies.
